# Bremsecu

Bremsecu is a patented, vehicle-independent heavy-vehicle diagnostic technology and measurement methodology.

## Core concept
Bremsecu combines direct electrical measurement, guided testing, correlated diagnostics and evidence-based reporting. It is designed to help technicians verify the physical electrical layer rather than rely only on fault codes or OEM-specific software paths.

## Current scope
- Heavy-vehicle electrical diagnostics
- ISO 7638 measurement and verification
- ISO 12098 measurement and verification
- Pin-level electrical measurement
- Cable continuity and cross-connection testing
- Functional testing
- CAN termination checks under safe de-energized conditions
- Ground and return-path verification
- Guided mobile workflow
- Detailed diagnostic reporting

## Methodology
The system guides technicians through a defined measurement sequence, applies safety and evaluation logic, correlates related results and directs the user toward the likely fault area and next verification step.

Bremsecu is designed for rapid technician adoption: a technician comfortable using a smartphone can learn the operating workflow in a short time.

## Service impact
Manual heavy-vehicle electrical diagnosis may require repeated measurements, reference comparisons, wiring checks and manual note-taking. Bremsecu is designed to reduce diagnostic processes that can take 6–8 hours manually to a matter of minutes in appropriate test scenarios.
